label: Independence of elementary facts
resolution: Individual or pairwise value realization does not entail full joint report saturation. Full saturation concerns a supplied set of designated elementary coordinates; reanalysis can instead classify the third report as a composite over an independently saturated two-report basis. No blanket independence of all propositions, probabilistic independence, actual metaphysical admissibility or historical analysis is inferred. The selected-fragment theorem is not a representation of all infinite-world coordinates.
